audit.whatIsWrong: The page says in two places that Mourning Mist hands Fiora a free STUN off Riposte: early warns 'never throw E Mourning Mist when her W is up or you hand her a free stun/parry', and wants.foe[0] reads 'Riposte parrying your E slow and stun'.
audit.why: Riposte stabs and SLOWS the first champion hit, and only stuns 'if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with this ability'. Mourning Mist applies a slow, and a slow is not an immobilise. Nothing in Yorick's kit immobilises at all — Dark Procession is terrain, not crowd control. So Riposte against Yorick is a parry that never upgrades to a stun, and the player has been taught to fear a thing that cannot happen while the real cost, losing the damage window, goes unstated.
audit.corrected: Riposte is now described as parrying all incoming damage, stunning only when it blocks an immobilise, with the note that you have none.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows disagreed with their own why-text: win[2]/phases[2].side read 'Fiora' while whys[2] says level 3 is even; win[3] read 'Skill' while whys[3] says levels 4-5 favour Fiora; win[4] read 'Fiora' while whys[4] says level 6 is even; win[5] read 'Skill' while whys[5] says first item favours Fiora.
audit.why: The packet levelChart (Fiora, Fiora, Skill, Fiora, Skill, Fiora, Fiora) matches the prose on all four, and the mirror audit independently moved its win[3] and win[5] to Fiora.
audit.corrected: Rows 2-5 flipped across both layers as one atomic pair-matched group with ratings brought along. Row 6 deliberately left as Fiora — see notes.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Riposte's cooldown 'low' twice (whys[5], late) and names it as the tracked cooldown in twelve fields without ever giving the number.
audit.why: Riposte is 24s at rank 1 and only reaches 16s at rank 5 — it is not low early, and that gap is the entire reason a level 3-5 Yorick has any window at all. Lunge is 13s at rank 1 falling to 6s, which is the cooldown that actually shortens dangerously as she levels. Grand Challenge is 110/90/70s.
audit.corrected: 24s now appears in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t, spikes[0].text and mid; Lunge's 13s in spikes[0].text; Grand Challenge's 110s in spikes[1].text and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Executioner's Calling sits in report[8].t but no lane text ever ties anti-heal to a moment, and nothing mentions that Lunge applies on-hit effects.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags two rules here. 'needs-antiheal': Duelist's Dance heals her on every Vital hit and Grand Challenge heals her and nearby allies if she hits all four Vitals or the target dies — so the ghoul-chip plan loses to her sustain unless Grievous Wounds is already applied. 'onhit-itemization': Lunge applies on-hit effects, so her damage scales with what she buys rather than with raw AD, and reading the trade purely through armour misprices it.
audit.corrected: early, mid, spikes[1].text and dontsFull[1].d now require Grievous Wounds before you accept the all-in, with the Vital heal named as the reason.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 belong to Fiora — she walks up, Q Lunges to your passive-vital side, and her early Q damage plus vital procs out-trade your autos. Respect Riposte: never throw E Mourning Mist when her W is up or you hand her a free stun/parry and a burst window. Farm defensively with Q Last Rites, give ground rather than eat vital trades, and don't try to cage a champ who dashes.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 belong to Fiora — she walks up, Lunges to your revealed Vital, and her early Q damage plus the Vital heal out-trade your autos. Riposte stuns only if it blocks an immobilise and nothing in your kit immobilises, so it eats your damage but never locks you down. Farm defensively with Last Rites, give ground rather than feed Vitals, and buy Grievous Wounds early.

edits.before: At 3-5 she snowballs the lane with W Riposte, which parries your E slow and any Maiden auto, and Q Lunge lets her weave around your Dark Procession wall to hit vitals. Level 6 Grand Challenge is a hard all-in you should not accept without ghouls, Maiden, and a clear Riposte — her true damage and heal will out-sustain your chip.
